scenes.heading: Life in one line
scenes.narration: Conway's Game of Life, in one line of X_eTaL.
lines: Conway's Game of Life, in X_eTaL.
The whole rule is one line of array code.

scenes.heading: The rule: read it right to left
scenes.narration: Here is the whole rule. Read it right to left: rotate the board, add the copies up, and compare.

scenes.heading: 1. Nine shifted copies
scenes.narration: Rotate the board by minus one, zero and one along both axes. That gives nine shifted copies: one for each neighbor, and the cell itself.

scenes.heading: 2. Add them up
scenes.narration: Add the nine copies. Now every cell holds its own value plus its eight neighbors.

scenes.heading: 3. Compare
scenes.narration: A cell lives next when the sum is three, or when it is alive and the sum is four.

scenes.heading: Run it: the R-pentomino
scenes.narration: Run it. Five cells, the R pentomino, on a sixteen by sixteen board that wraps around.

scenes.heading: Try it live
scenes.narration: Step through it yourself in the browser.
